limits: Both environment versions and policies are synthetic; survival is only within this simulator.
The pulse-trace controller is a hand-coded positive control, not a learned policy or proof of memory emergence.
The NEXUS agent comparison uses two fixed random initializations; environment seeds do not substitute for additional trained lineages.
This assay is not a controller promotion gate and does not test the residual adapter.
The v2 environment changes only rest hydration recovery; it is not a general ecology or real-world safety model.

protocol.action_contract: same four actions: forage, shelter, explore, rest
protocol.agent_comparison: same random initialization and same environment seed, v1 structured world prior versus v2 hydration-aligned prior
protocol.observation_contract: same 8 float32 channels; channel 3 transient storm pulse and channel 4 episode progress
protocol.primary_task_validity_gate: three-tick pulse-trace controller survival >= 0.95 on v2
protocol.version_change: v2 adds +0.12 hydration to Rest before the unchanged -0.05 basal hydration drain; v1 remains untouched
